title: File:Hand-painted village map signboard in Himachal Pradesh.jpg
description: This photograph shows a hand-painted informational signboard displaying a village map in Hindi, installed by a Gram Panchayat in a rural area of Himachal Pradesh, India. The map illustrates the layout of the village, including houses, roads, a river, forest areas, and key locations such as schools. Such signboards are commonly used in rural regions to provide basic geographic and administrative information to residents and visitors.

Anything thatwill hold the wax at an even temperature will do, an electric stove, gasburner, or alcohol burner. A bowl of wax may be set in the top of a tea-kettle of boiling water and will remain hot enough to use for half anhour without reheating the water. All danger of burning the wax is elim-inated by keeping the wax in a bowl set in a pan of water. If the wateris kept just below the boiling point, that will give sufficient heat. In covering a large space, it is sometimes better to begin waxing in thecenter and working outward toward the edge.
